Ari / team — thanks for the clear replies. Below are the legal redlines I suggest for the Order Form and the MSA cross-reference. These are intended to be narrow, operational, and to limit revenue & tax exposure for Redwood.

Proposed redline snippets (to be inserted into Order Form / Billing section):

1) Invoice Recipient (new field on Order Form header):
"Invoice Recipient: [Customer Legal Entity Name]. Redwood will issue PDF invoices and remittance advices to the invoice recipient specified on the Order Form. Customer must provide full legal entity name and tax/VAT identifier at signing."

2) Billing & Tranche Invoicing (replace Annual Prepay clause):
"Minimum Commit Tranches: The Annual Minimum Commitment shall be invoiced in quarterly tranches as set forth in the Order Form. Redwood will issue each tranche invoice thirty (30) days prior to the beginning of the applicable quarter. Customer shall issue a PO or authorization for each tranche at least fourteen (14) days prior to the invoice date. Failure to provide a PO may result in suspension of the Net45 payment exception and revert to Net30."

3) Taxes & Withholding (tightened language):
"Taxes; Withholding: Unless otherwise stated, amounts payable under this Order Form are exclusive of taxes. If Customer is required by applicable law to withhold or deduct taxes from payments to Redwood, Customer shall (a) withhold such taxes, (b) provide Redwood with official withholding tax certificates or government receipts within sixty (60) days of payment, and (c) promptly pay any additional amounts necessary so that Redwood receives the amounts it would have received absent such withholding (a 'gross-up'), unless otherwise agreed in writing. If Customer does not provide acceptable withholding documentation, Redwood may, in its discretion, (i) issue an adjusted credit to Customer or (ii) require Customer to remit the gross-up amount."
4) Net Terms (exception guardrails):
"Net45 Exception: Notwithstanding the MSA, Redwood may, in its sole discretion and subject to finance approval, grant Net45 for a given tranche provided Customer (a) issues an approved PO for the tranche amount, and (b) supplies any requested credit references. Redwood may withdraw Net45 privileges with thirty (30) days' notice upon material change to Customer's credit profile."

Next steps: 
- If Ari confirms the EU billing entity name and VAT ID (Ari confirmed above), Ben to upload final tracked v4 with these exact snippets inserted.
- Jonas/Finance to confirm Net45 credit approval for this account — if approved, we will mark the Net45 checkbox and proceed to DocuSign.
- Kimberly to ensure invoicing system can route PDF invoices with the Invoice Recipient field and VAT ID.

I'll stand by to review the final v4. Once the language is in place, Ben — you can send the DocuSign envelope to Ari and Marcus and cc our revenue ops inbox.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
